storyCards.headline: I Can't Dance: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Genesis's "I Can't Dance" reached #7 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #7 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

I Can't Dance was released in 1992.

Album: Live: The Way We Walk Volume 1 (1992).

Chart story — peaked at #7 on the Hot 100.
